## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive; mixed internals with Materials/Healthcare/Consumer Staples leading while Technology/Financials/Industrials lag — confirms a neutral, undecided tape. Leadership concentration: concentrated across 3 sectors in Top 5, and major divergence among large caps (NVDA, PANW, JPM, XOM), so signals are mixed and muted.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Materials lead: FCX (1W: +20.49% | 1M: +27.41%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +16.52% | 1M: +44.58%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare strong: MRK (1W: +15.74% | 1M: +19.65%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +8.21% | 1M: +9.91%) ABOVE TREND; Consumer Staples strength anchored by EL (1W: +24.42% | 1M: +26.02%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Energy and Utilities are weak: XOM (1W: -2.97% | 1M: +4.46%) TREND EXHAUSTION, CVX (1W: -2.00% | 1M: +6.12%) TREND EXHAUSTION; Industrials soft: LMT (1W: -8.34% | 1M: -4.05%) BELOW TREND, GE (1W: -6.81% | 1M: -3.34%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: EL (1W: +24.42% | 1M: +26.02%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +20.49% | 1M: +27.41%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +16.52% | 1M: +44.58%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +15.74% | 1M: +19.65%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +8.21% | 1M: +9.91%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership concentration: concentrated across Materials/Healthcare/Staples (3 sectors); Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: AVGO (1W: -6.12% | 1M: -6.91%) BELOW TREND, NUE (1W: -6.30% | 1M: -0.13%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -6.57% | 1M: -7.03%) BELOW TREND, RTX (1W: -6.75% | 1M: -3.41%) BELOW TREND, GE (1W: -6.81% | 1M: -3.34%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select Tech and Industrial names.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Strongest 1W momentum: EL (1W: +24.42%), FCX (1W: +20.49%), NEM (1W: +16.52%), MRK (1W: +15.74%), ACN (1W: +8.10%) ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR divergence: multiple large-cap names (NVDA, PANW, JPM, XOM, CVX) show conflicting 1W vs 1M signals — tactical volatility likely.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed with signs of fatigue: MSFT (1W: +2.29% | 1M: +26.61%) ABOVE TREND and GOOGL (1W: +0.80% | 1M: +6.25%) ABOVE TREND, while NVDA (1W: -3.04% | 1M: +8.42%) shows TREND EXHAUSTION and AVGO (1W: -6.12% | 1M: -6.91%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W performance is slightly negative and internals are uneven, so watch for rotation within Tech.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials are mixed/soft: V (1W: +5.46% | 1M: +6.16%) ABOVE TREND and MA (1W: +4.36% | 1M: +8.64%) ABOVE TREND contrast with JPM (1W: -1.81% | 1M: +0.14%) TREND EXHAUSTION. Sector 1W is marginally negative and breadth is uneven, so Financials are not uniform leaders.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Healthcare showing strength and leadership breadth: MRK (1W: +15.74% | 1M: +19.65%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +8.21% | 1M: +9.91%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +1.25% | 1M: +3.21%) ABOVE TREND. Positive news flow (FDA approval wins) is confirming price action in several names.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor exposure to Materials and select Healthcare and Consumer Staples leaders (FCX, MRK, EL) while reducing exposure to strained Tech/Industrial laggards (AVGO, AMAT, LMT). Given NEUTRAL regime and major divergences, remain selective and size positions cautiously.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: EL (1W: +24.42% | 1M: +26.02%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +20.49% | 1M: +27.41%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +15.74% | 1M: +19.65%) ABOVE TREND — momentum confirmed by news. BEARISH: AVGO (1W: -6.12% | 1M: -6.91%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -9.53% | 1M: -4.57%) BELOW TREND — watch for follow-through.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Materials — strong 1W leaders and positive sentiment on miners. BEARISH: Energy/Utilities — 1W weakness and trend exhaustion in major names warrant monitoring.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Watch NVDA (1W: -3.04% | 1M: +8.42%) TREND EXHAUSTION for a confirmed 1W reversal; AAPL (1W: -0.04% | 1M: -7.94%) BELOW TREND for continuation of weakness; FCX (1W: +20.49% | 1M: +27.41%) ABOVE TREND as a momentum support test.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
EL (+80): Estée Lauder EPS guidance and dividend affirmation — price ABOVE TREND (1W: +24.42% | 1M: +26.02%) confirming accumulation. JNJ (+75): FDA approval for Imaavy — price ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.25% | 1M: +3.21%) confirming. CEG (+80): Guidance raise — watch price-action vs utility group weakness.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
INTU (-60): weak FY27 guidance — check price for confirmation (trend status not provided here). AVGO (-50): earnings concerns — price BELOW TREND (1W: -6.12% | 1M: -6.91%) confirming distribution. WMT (-45): earnings miss headlines — price BELOW TREND (1W: -8.31% | 1M: -5.47%) confirming.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. Materials and Healthcare show the most relative strength (FCX ABOVE TREND, MRK ABOVE TREND, EL ABOVE TREND). Major divergence among large caps (NVDA, PANW, JPM, XOM) and mixed sentiment headlines are the key risks to monitor.
